title: Unitree G1 Walking Demo: Baseline, Push, Correction, Preview
subtitle: Generated from Unitree RL Gym. D0-D3 compare the same locomotion base under four test conditions.
source_notice: Videos are generated locally from Unitree's open-source G1 MuJoCo policy. The gait is supplied by Unitree RL Gym.

scenes.title: D0 Baseline: Unitree G1 walking
scenes.claim: Unitree's open-source G1 MuJoCo policy generates the walking motion. No external push or added correction is applied.

scenes.title: D1 Push Test: Unitree policy only
scenes.claim: A scripted lateral push is applied while only the Unitree locomotion policy is active.

scenes.title: D2 Push Test: Interaction Dynamics MPC correction
scenes.claim: The same lateral push is applied, with an Interaction Dynamics MPC correction sent as a high-level lateral velocity command.
metrics: compare lateral deviation and recovery time

scenes.title: D3 Planned Load: Preview correction
scenes.claim: A known upcoming lateral load is previewed before it arrives, so the correction starts proactively.
